$comment: AREA project settings (tracked, travels with the clone). Merged with the local, gitignored .claude/settings.local.json. The PreToolUse hook HARD-enforces the oracle-loop's independence rule: it blocks edits to a LOCKED holdout oracle at the editor level, turning CLAUDE.md's 'never edit a locked holdout' from a request into a block. NOTE: project hooks run only once the user APPROVES them in Claude Code (fresh clones must trust the project first); until then this is advisory and tools/verify-holdout-intact.sh remains the deterministic backstop. The command fails OPEN if the script can't be located (e.g. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset) so it can never block all edits. See tools/hooks/guard_holdout.py.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/hooks/guard_holdout.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 -I "$f"; else exit 0; fi
